newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela H1 growth seen at 1.0 to 1.5 pct -Parra.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela H1 growth seen at 1.0 to 1.5 pct -Parra.

text.p: Venezuelan economic growth over the first half of the year reached between one and 1.5 percent, Minister of Trade Commerce Freddy Rojas Parra said.

"Growth could be between one and 1.5 percent," Parra said in a radio interview, citing increased credit demand and rising consumption of electricity and construction goods as just some of the signs of growing economic activity.
The government has forecast over five percent growth for 1997 after the economy shrank 1.6 percent in last year.
